zh.title: 加拿大航空公佈A321XLR新航線 蒙特婁與哈利法克斯連接歐洲
zh.summary: 加拿大航空公佈A321XLR新航線；提供14個平躺商務艙套房與免費WiFi
body: 加拿大航空（Air Canada）公佈全新的A321XLR航線，將開通蒙特婁（Montreal）與哈利法克斯（Halifax）飛往歐洲的新航點，飛行時間最長達8小時。
根據標題所述，這是一條新的8小時直飛A321XLR航線，但其中「有轉折」。
航空公司同時表示，A321XLR開通從蒙特婁與哈利法克斯前往歐洲的新航線，並提供14個平躺式商務艙套房，以及免費WiFi服務。
此次公佈為新航線計畫，相關詳細細節與營運時間表仍待後續確認。

en.title: Air Canada reveals new A321XLR routes from Montreal and Halifax to Europe with lie-flat suites and WiFi
en.summary: Air Canada reveals new A321XLR routes from Montreal and Halifax to Europe, with 14 lie-flat suites and free WiFi.
body: Air Canada has revealed a new A321XLR route, opening new links from Montreal and Halifax to Europe with nonstop flights of up to eight hours. The headline notes "But There's A Twist", indicating that further specifics about the plans remain to be clarified.

According to the airline's announcement, the A321XLR service will feature 14 lie-flat business suites and complimentary WiFi. The revealed routes represent a plan, with further operational details and schedule specifics still pending confirmation.
